description: Checks if a 9x9 Sudoku board is valid by verifying that each row, column, and 3x3 sub-grid contains no duplicate digits 1-9. Returns true if valid, false otherwise. (cost: 1 credit)

board.description: array, required, 9x9 2D array representing the Sudoku board with digits 1-9 or empty cells

name: validate_sudoku
